messages:
emma.partnerships: Quick kickoff — GearShift (HSM vendor) asked about a joint marketplace listing + SSO/SCIM + KMS/BYO support. Can we sync on who owns which pieces and an announcement window? :wave:
ajay.eng: I can own the SCIM and SSO parts (they want SAML + OIDC). For SCIM we need a mapping doc — GearShift uses group-centric attrs and has a slightly different user schema. I will draft the mapping. ETA: EOD tomorrow for the spec draft.
lina.secops: Heads-up: their HSM claims FIPS 140-2 L3 but we need vendor attestation + pen test report before public launch. Also request PKCS#11 + KMIP compatibility matrix. I’ll start the compliance checklist.
emma.partnerships: Thanks. From GTM side we want a soft co-announcement in two weeks and a deeper joint webinar 4 weeks after. Is that doable if engineering + security clear?
ajay.eng: Two weeks for a soft announcement is tight but possible if we ship a feature-flagged SCIM endpoint and SSO docs. For KMS: GearShift will expose a KMIP endpoint and a BYOK flow. We need to decide if we integrate directly or use their connector (they provide a connector binary).
mike.sre: If we're pulling a connector binary into Dedicated/Private, we need packaging + automated smoke tests. Suggest a canary rollout plan: staging -> dedicated-test -> 10% prod -> full. Also need hardware-in-the-loop tests for KV cache + cold-start performance.
lina.secops: Also require short threat model for the connector and a supply-chain scan of the binary. If they won't open-source it, we need code signing proof and reproducible build artifacts.
emma.partnerships: Agreed. Ajay, can you put the SCIM draft in a PR and link to it here? Mike, can you draft the canary runbook? Lina, I'll DM you for the specific attestation ask.
ajay.eng: Pushed a minimal SCIM spec to https://git.redwood.ai/partners/gearshift/scim-mapping (WIP) — includes user/group attribs and sample payload. Quick curl example added:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"userName":"jdoe","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"}}'
```
Note: test tenant credentials are in 1Password.
mike.sre: Created an initial runbook draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/gearshift-canary (linking infra playbook). I added steps for smoke tests, log flags to watch, and rollback criteria. Need an owner for the infra step that deploys the connector.
lina.secops: Uploaded the security checklist to the same docs folder and added required artifacts: vendor attestation, pen test summary, SBOM, code-sign cert. Marking items required before soft public mention.
emma.partnerships: Thanks all. Next steps: 1) Ajay finish SCIM + SSO docs (tomorrow) 2) Mike finalize canary runbook and owner (3 days) 3) Lina confirm attestation+SBOM status (5 days) 4) I’ll coordinate PR/comms and schedule a rehearsed co-announcement.
ajay.eng: On it. Will also add a short compatibility note for PKCS#11 vs KMIP and whether we will support both or only KMIP initially.
mike.sre: I’ll reach out to infra-owner @zach to schedule the packaging task. planning to add a deploy-bot hook for the canary.
deploy-bot: Build artifact gearshift-connector:v0.1.0 uploaded to gs://redwood-artifacts/gearshift/1763334444 (sha256: abc123...); automated smoke tests queued.
emma.partnerships: Great — let's do a 30min sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to lock timeline. If anyone can't make it, drop notes here. :calendar:
